title: Anyone else?
content: Has anyone been waking up from there dreams in the middle of the night beyond thirsty? Feeling super dehydrated/ feeling like they are going to pass out. It feels like a hangover dehydration thirst if that makes sense except I don’t drink. I am always well hydrated and this has happened multiple times the past few weeks . It’s like the dream not only mentally exhausts me but physically as well. And I am always so tired it feels like I never even get sleep.
